claims.sentence: The evaluation schedule is brought to your attention under signature no less than 30 (thirty) calendar days before the scheduled evaluation date
The schedule is compiled according to the form in Appendix 2 to the regulation
If you are directly present at the Evaluation Commission meeting, your evaluation results are communicated to you after the voting results are tallied
If you are absent from the meeting, your results are communicated to you on the next working day
If it is impossible to personally acquaint you with the results, a notification is sent to you via email
For you after you pass the evaluation, the secretary of the Evaluation Commission draws up an extract from the protocol no later than 2 (two) working days from the day the evaluation was conducted
The extract is compiled according to the form in Appendix 5 to the regulation
The extract contains your surname, first name, patronymic, position name, the date of the commission meeting, the voting results, the adopted decision, and the commission's decision
You are acquainted with the extract under signature within 10 (ten) working days from the day the meeting was conducted
If you refuse to familiarize yourself with the extract, an act according to Appendix 4 is drawn up
A copy of the extract is kept in your personal file in the HR department
The evidence does not specify the email address or platform used for the notification
The evidence does not state the procedure if the 10-working-day deadline for signing the extract is exceeded
The evidence does not clarify whether the schedule notification applies to all teaching staff or only specific categories
The evidence does not provide the actual forms for Appendix 2, Appendix 4, or Appendix 5
The evidence does not explain the procedure if you are absent and email notification is also impossible
The regulation does not state how to handle conflicts if a course page provides different notification procedures
